completeness.why: Every bulk action takes its category selection (income-in-tracking rule and hidden rule) from shouldFillCategory/getMonthFillCategories with an explicit hidden-mode argument ('include' for setZero, 'skip' for copyPreviousMonth, 'skip-unless-visible' for the averages), the SQL hidden filters are gone, and both sign inversions go through averageToBudgetAmount; copyPreviousMonth only passes its own budget rows.

interface.why: One function with a single named enum parameter that encodes exactly the three existing hidden behaviours (including the null-group difference) as explicit, documented variations; no speculative options, plus a small sign helper.

disguised_duplication.where: The income and hidden checks and the sign inversion were removed from all sites and exist only in shouldFillCategory and averageToBudgetAmount.
